correctness.rationale: The Higgins balanced-weighting criterion is translated to six exact Hall inequalities d_i>=ceil(q/3), a_i<=floor(q/3); counting incidences produces the sharp residue-wise lower bounds. Equality cases exhaust singleton-only (q=0 mod3), one triple or two distinct doubles (q=1 mod3), and two distinct doubles (q=2 mod3). Multinomial label counts include q=1 separately. Independent multiset enumeration of all seven nonempty support types for q=1..7 reproduces both minima and multiplicities; finite data corroborate rather than prove arbitrary q.
